pages.text: While active, restore one saturation per second, capped by your food level. Mining speed scales up to 2×, and attack damage scales up to 15% more. Movement and attack speed also increase slightly.

pages.title: High Intensity
pages.text: Breathing, heartbeat, brightness and tremor grow stronger with intensity. Strong amounts can prevent sleep. Very high amounts can cause lethal overdose. Sources include coca tea, dried leaves, powder and a syringe.
